reader.requirement: At --std 85 every argument-1 of FUNCTION MEDIAN must be class numeric, i.e. an arithmetic expression (§1989:A.2.2 AR1): numeric items of any usage and scale, numeric literals, expressions, numeric/integer function-identifiers and table(ALL) references are accepted, and an alphabetic, alphanumeric (including numeric-edited, alphanumeric-edited, group and reference-modified) argument, a nonnumeric literal or an alphanumeric function is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: ArgPredicate.AppliesAt(edition year) gates per-position predicates; the MEDIAN row carries none, so nothing switches for this rule
IndexDataItemAdmittedAt(DialectLevel): an index data item as a function argument is refused COBOL6979 at 85 (§1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5) where 2023 refuses it COBOL1627 through the class screen; both refuse

reader.edition-search: grep of IntrinsicBinder.cs for IsAvailable/DialectLevel/Edition.Edition/AppliesAt/DialectBehaviors and of IntrinsicArgumentRules.cs for Since/Edition/Version/1985: the MEDIAN Verified row (Uniform 'n') and the class lattice are edition-blind; the only edition consult on this path is the index-data-item context in ExpressionBinder#OperandRef.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the class screen is the same code at 85 and 2023; only the diagnostic for an index data item argument differs (COBOL6979 at 85, COBOL1627 at 2023), both refusals
